get.summary: List graphs (scoped credentials see only bound graphs)
get.description: Requires the admin token, the read-only token, or a scoped credential with graph_read whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]). Collection scope never implies graph scope. Runs under one database read guard.

post.description: Requires the admin token or a scoped credential with graph_write whose graphs binding names the new graph (or is ["*"]).

post.summary: Get one node by ID or key
post.description: Requires the admin token, the read-only token, or a scoped credential with graph_read whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]). Collection scope never implies graph scope. Runs under one database read guard.

node.description: Exactly one of id or key

id.description: u64 as a canonical decimal string (preferred) or JSON integer

limits.description: Unset fields use GraphLimits::DEFAULT (max_hops 2, max_visited_nodes 1000, max_edges_examined 10000, max_edges_per_node 1000, deadline_ms 250, max_output_nodes 100, max_output_edges 200, max_output_paths 20). Values above the ceiling (4, 10000, 100000, 10000, 5000, 1000, 2000, 100) are rejected with 422 graph_limit_exceeds_ceiling, never clamped.

schema.description: Same JSON as vlite-graph-cli: graph, view_sequence (decimal string), complete, truncation, stats, cursor, and node | edge | nodes | edges | paths | shortest_path. Results carry graph structure only, never vector record data.

403.description: forbidden_scope: credential lacks graph_read or the graph is outside its graphs binding; read_only does not apply to graph reads

409.description: graphs_not_enabled (vector-only file), graph_not_found, graph_cursor_stale or another graph conflict

422.description: invalid_json (unknown field, bad ID), invalid_input (bad cursor), graph_limit_exceeds_ceiling or graph_invalid_options

post.description: Requires the admin token or graph_write on this graph. attach, detach, put_vector and delete_vector additionally require the write operation and a collection binding covering each named collection, and delete_node does the same for every collection attached to the node. Collection names are matched exactly as stored, never tenant-qualified: a tenanted signed-in account names its own collections t<tenant_id>__<name>. Live-vector quotas apply. Runs under the database write guard as one durable frame; nothing is written on error.

items.description: One of create_node, upsert_node, patch_node, delete_node, create_edge, patch_edge, delete_edge, attach, detach, put_vector, delete_vector (vlite-graph-cli batch JSON).

409.description: graphs_not_enabled or a graph conflict (graph_key_exists, graph_node_not_found, graph_attachment_conflict, graph_schema_violation, ...)

422.description: invalid_json, invalid_input (more than 4096 operations, invalid vector or metadata)

get.summary: Graph read/write guard hold times (admin only)
get.description: Hold time of the database guard per graph request in microseconds over the most recent 4096 samples (nearest-rank p50/p99, max), total counts and truncation counts by reason since start.
